summary_ja: 普通株式等Tier1資本の基礎項目（算入可能な項目）と調整項目（控除すべき項目）を列挙し、各種閾値調整（10%・15%基準等）の算出方法を規定する条文。
summary_en: Enumerates the basic items (eligible components) and adjustment items (deductions) of Common Equity Tier 1 Capital and prescribes the calculation of threshold-based adjustments such as the 10% and 15% thresholds.
